generation.operation: GENERATE: new card composition with designated originals as layout/style references

visualChecks.method: Direct manual visual inspection of generation and the saved PNG using view_image; every word checked, no OCR

ability.observed: Один раз запретите всем игрокам строительство на следующий раунд

purpleMedallion.observed: Gold rim, deep purple field, pink ornamental emblem

wholeCard.observed: Complete full-face rectangle, all three coins, parchment, separate title ribbon and purple medallion inside image; no mockup or external padding

scene.observed: Stone civic judicial hall, arched windows, raised heavy carved wooden bench with scales symbol, one robed judge raising an open stopping hand, scribe, two principal petitioners including craftsman with rolled building plan, wax seals and rolled decrees. Additional peripheral partial onlookers appear at the left edge and lower right.

paintedAtmosphere.observed: Soft natural daylight, warm wood and pale stone, serious civic authority, restrained clothes; natural painted rendering rather than photo or 3D

noExtraReadableText.observed: Only approved district title and ability are readable; banners bear pictorial scales symbols without words

limitations: Text and coin checks are manual visual checks; no OCR performed.
The generated room has ornate high-backed judicial furniture and scales banners. These are generative scene choices, not literal reference copying.
Two main petitioners are supplemented by partial peripheral onlookers, slightly exceeding the requested 1–2 supporting people.
Final dimensions, lower title margin, baseline alignment and JPEG weight are deferred until artistic approval.
No numeric color or brushwork match to originals is claimed.
